description: Surveying teaches how land is measured and mapped: field safety, surveying a lot with instruments and GPS, finding elevations, reading a deed, new technologies like drones and laser scanning, and careers in surveying.
outlineNote: The official page lists eight requirements, but only seven topics were visible in the excerpts (field safety, a lot survey, elevations, reading a deed, drones and laser scanning, GPS, and careers), so no requirement outline is published yet.
